snippet.title: Love & Fool's Gold | Official Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Love & Fool's Gold is a choice-driven romance-mystery visual novel set in the Wild West, where every decision shapes your story.🤠

Arriving in the gold rush town of Cortez Creek to hunt down a bounty, you soon discover that something far more sinister lurks beneath its dusty streets. Build relationships, choose who to trust, uncover hidden secrets, and confront the dark horror that's threatening the town.

This is so much more than a cowboy dating sim.

🩷 Play the FREE demo on Steam:
➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4066670/Love__Fools_Gold/

Features

• 🤠 A choice-driven narrative where your decisions matter
• 💘 Romance three unique partners, each with their own story
• 🔎 Investigate the mysteries surrounding Cortez Creek
• 👁️ Uncover an ancient Eldritch horror hidden beneath the Wild West
• 🎙️ Fully voiced characters
• 🎨 Beautiful hand-drawn artwork and CG illustrations
• 🔀 Multiple endings and branching story paths

Follow us for updates!
